duas.excerptUthmani: ٱهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ ۝ صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
duas.meaningEn: Guide us to the straight path — the path of those upon whom You have bestowed favour, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray.

duas.excerptUthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَكَ لَا عِلْمَ لَنَآ إِلَّا مَا عَلَّمْتَنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
duas.meaningEn: Exalted are You; we have no knowledge except what You have taught us. Indeed, it is You who is the Knowing, the Wise.

duas.excerptUthmani: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمُ رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْ هَـٰذَا بَلَدًا ءَامِنًا وَٱرْزُقْ أَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ مَنْ ءَامَنَ مِنْهُم بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, make this a secure city and provide its people with fruits — those among them who believe in Allah and the Last Day.

duas.titleAr: دعاء إبراهيم وإسماعيل عند بناء الكعبة
duas.excerptUthmani: وَإِذْ يَرْفَعُ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمُ ٱلْقَوَاعِدَ مِنَ ٱلْبَيْتِ وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلُ رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّآ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ۝ رَبَّنَا وَٱجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَآ أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ۝ رَبَّنَا وَٱبْعَثْ فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِّنْهُمْ يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتِكَ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
duas.meaningEn: Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing. Our Lord, and make us Muslims [in submission] to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation. Show us our rites and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful. Our Lord, send among them a messenger from themselves who will recite to them Your verses and teach them the Book and wisdom and purify them.

duas.excerptUthmani: رَبَّنَا وَٱجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَآ أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
duas.meaningEn: Our Lord, and make us Muslims [in submission] to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation [in submission] to You. And show us our rites and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.

duas.excerptUthmani: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
duas.meaningEn: Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

duas.titleEn: Ṭālūt's Prayer for Patience in Battle
duas.titleAr: دعاء طالوت وجنوده عند لقاء العدو
duas.excerptUthmani: رَبَّنَآ أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
duas.meaningEn: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.

duas.excerptUthmani: ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦ ۚ وَقَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ ۝ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ ۖ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
duas.meaningEn: Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.

duas.excerptUthmani: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ ۝ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ ٱلنَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
duas.meaningEn: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower. Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt.

duas.titleEn: Believers' Simple Prayer — Faith, Forgiveness, Fire
duas.titleAr: دعاء المؤمنين المقتصد — الإيمان والمغفرة والنجاة
duas.excerptUthmani: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
duas.meaningEn: Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

duas.excerptUthmani: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ مَـٰلِكَ ٱلْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِى ٱلْمُلْكَ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَنزِعُ ٱلْمُلْكَ مِمَّن تَشَآءُ وَتُعِزُّ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَن تَشَآءُ ۖ بِيَدِكَ ٱلْخَيْرُ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.meaningEn: Say, 'O Allah, Owner of Sovereignty, You give sovereignty to whom You will and You take sovereignty away from whom You will. You honour whom You will and You humble whom You will. In Your hand is all good. Indeed, You are over all things competent.'

duas.titleEn: Hannah's Vow — Dedicating the Unborn Child to Allah
duas.titleAr: دعاء حنَّة بنذر الطفل لله وتعويذ مريم من الشيطان
duas.excerptUthmani: رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ۝ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَضَعْتُهَآ أُنثَىٰ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا وَضَعَتْ وَلَيْسَ ٱلذَّكَرُ كَٱلْأُنثَىٰ ۖ وَإِنِّى سَمَّيْتُهَا مَرْيَمَ وَإِنِّىٓ أُعِيذُهَا بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated for Your service, so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing. My Lord, I have delivered a female… I have named her Mary, and I seek refuge for her in You and her descendants from Satan, the expelled.

duas.excerptUthmani: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.

duas.titleEn: The Disciples of Jesus — Register Us Among the Witnesses
duas.excerptUthmani: رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا بِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ وَٱتَّبَعْنَا ٱلرَّسُولَ فَٱكْتُبْنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
duas.meaningEn: Our Lord, we have believed in what You revealed and have followed the messenger, so register us among the witnesses to truth.

duas.excerptUthmani: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِىٓ أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
duas.meaningEn: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and the excess [committed] in our affairs and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.

duas.titleEn: Ḥasbunallāh — Allah is Sufficient for Us
duas.excerptUthmani: حَسْبُنَا ٱللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ ٱلْوَكِيلُ
duas.meaningEn: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.

duas.titleEn: The People of Understanding — Full Prayer
duas.excerptUthmani: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَـٰذَا بَـٰطِلًا سُبْحَـٰنَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ۝ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ ٱلنَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُۥ ۖ وَمَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ ۝ رَّبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِى لِلْإِيمَـٰنِ أَنْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَـَٔامَنَّا ۚ رَبَّنَا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّـَٔاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ ۝ رَبَّنَا وَءَاتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۗ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
duas.meaningEn: Our Lord, You did not create this without purpose — exalted are You. So protect us from the punishment of the Fire. Our Lord, whomever You admit to the Fire, You have certainly disgraced. Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith. Our Lord, forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous. Our Lord, grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection.

duas.titleEn: Gospel Believers' Prayer — Register Us Among the Witnesses
duas.titleAr: دعاء مؤمني أهل الإنجيل — اكتبنا مع الشاهدين
duas.excerptUthmani: رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱكْتُبْنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
duas.meaningEn: Our Lord, we have believed, so register us among the witnesses.

duas.titleEn: ʿĪsā's Prayer for the Heavenly Table
duas.titleAr: دعاء عيسى بن مريم للمائدة من السماء
duas.excerptUthmani: ٱللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَآ أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَآئِدَةً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَءَاخِرِنَا وَءَايَةً مِّنكَ ۖ وَٱرْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
duas.meaningEn: O Allah, our Lord, send down to us a table spread with food from the heaven to be for us a festival for the first of us and the last of us and a sign from You. And provide for us, and You are the best of providers.

duas.excerptUthmani: قُلْ إِنَّ صَلَاتِى وَنُسُكِى وَمَحْيَاىَ وَمَمَاتِى لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُۥ ۖ وَبِذَٰلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
duas.meaningEn: Say, 'Indeed, my prayer, my rites of sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds. No partner has He. And this I have been commanded, and I am the first of the Muslims.'

duas.excerptUthmani: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
duas.meaningEn: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.

duas.excerptUthmani: عَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا ٱفْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْفَـٰتِحِينَ
duas.meaningEn: In Allah we have relied. Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth, and You are the best of those who give decision.

duas.titleEn: The Sorcerers' Prayer — Patience and Muslim Death
duas.titleAr: دعاء سحرة فرعون بعد إيمانهم — الصبر والوفاة على الإسلام
duas.excerptUthmani: رَبَّنَآ أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
duas.meaningEn: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims in submission to You.

duas.excerptUthmani: رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِأَخِى وَأَدْخِلْنَا فِى رَحْمَتِكَ ۖ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the most merciful of the merciful.

duas.titleEn: Mūsā's Prayer on Mount Sinai — Forgiveness After the Golden Calf
duas.titleAr: دعاء موسى في الطور — المغفرة بعد فتنة العجل
duas.excerptUthmani: رَبِّ لَوْ شِئْتَ أَهْلَكْتَهُم مِّن قَبْلُ وَإِيَّـٰىَ ۖ أَتُهْلِكُنَا بِمَا فَعَلَ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ مِنَّآ ۖ إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا فِتْنَتُكَ تُضِلُّ بِهَا مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَهْدِى مَن تَشَآءُ ۖ أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا ۖ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْغَـٰفِرِينَ ۝ وَٱكْتُبْ لَنَا فِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنَّا هُدْنَآ إِلَيْكَ
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, if You had willed, You could have destroyed them before and me as well. Will You destroy us for what the foolish among us have done?… You are our Protector, so forgive us and have mercy upon us; and You are the best of forgivers. And decree for us in this world that which is good and also in the Hereafter. Indeed we have turned back to You.

duas.titleEn: Ḥasbiyallāh — Allah Alone is My Sufficiency
duas.titleAr: حسبي الله — توكل النبي ﷺ المطلق
duas.excerptUthmani: حَسْبِىَ ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ ۖ وَهُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
duas.meaningEn: Sufficient for me is Allah; there is no deity except Him. On Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.

duas.titleAr: دعاء أتباع موسى في مواجهة الظالمين
duas.excerptUthmani: عَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ ۝ وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
duas.meaningEn: In Allah we rely. Our Lord, make us not [objects of] trial for the wrongdoing people. And save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people.

duas.excerptUthmani: رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْـَٔلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِى بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ ۖ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِى وَتَرْحَمْنِىٓ أَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, I seek refuge with You from asking You for that which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have mercy upon me, I will be among the losers.

duas.titleEn: Shuʿayb's Complete Reliance — My Success Is Only Through Allah
duas.titleAr: إعلان شعيب التوكل الكامل — وما توفيقي إلا بالله
duas.excerptUthmani: وَمَا تَوْفِيقِىٓ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِ ۚ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ
duas.meaningEn: And my success is not but through Allah. Upon Him I have relied, and to Him I return.

duas.titleEn: Yūsuf's Prayer in Prison — Preferring Hardship Over Sin
duas.titleAr: دعاء يوسف في السجن — السجن أحبُّ إليه من المعصية
duas.excerptUthmani: رَبِّ ٱلسِّجْنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِمَّا يَدْعُونَنِىٓ إِلَيْهِ ۖ وَإِلَّا تَصْرِفْ عَنِّى كَيْدَهُنَّ أَصْبُ إِلَيْهِنَّ وَأَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِينَ
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, prison is more to my liking than what they invite me to. And if You do not avert from me their plan, I might incline toward them and thus be of the ignorant.

duas.titleEn: Yūsuf's Final Prayer — To Die as a Muslim Among the Righteous
duas.titleAr: دعاء يوسف الجامع — التوفِّي مسلماً والإلحاق بالصالحين
duas.excerptUthmani: رَبِّ قَدْ ءَاتَيْتَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِى مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَنتَ وَلِىِّۦ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۖ تَوَفَّنِى مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, You have given me of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams. Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my protector in this world and in the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous.

duas.titleEn: Ibrahim's Prayer — Protect Me and My Children from Idols
duas.titleAr: دعاء إبراهيم — اجنبني وبنيَّ أن نعبد الأصنام
duas.excerptUthmani: رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْ هَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدَ ءَامِنًا وَٱجْنُبْنِى وَبَنِىَّ أَن نَّعْبُدَ ٱلْأَصْنَامَ ۝ رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضْلَلْنَ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۖ فَمَن تَبِعَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّى ۖ وَمَنْ عَصَانِى فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, make this city secure and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols. My Lord, indeed they have led astray many among the people. So whoever follows me is of me; and whoever disobeys me — indeed, You are Forgiving and Merciful.

duas.excerptUthmani: رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِى مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآءِ ۝ رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and from my descendants. Our Lord, accept my supplication. Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.

duas.excerptUthmani: رَّبِّ ٱرْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِى صَغِيرًا
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small.

duas.titleEn: Prayer for Righteous Entry and Exit
duas.excerptUthmani: رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِى مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِى مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَٱجْعَل لِّى مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَـٰنًا نَّصِيرًا
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority.

duas.titleEn: Prayer of the Companions of the Cave
duas.excerptUthmani: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
duas.meaningEn: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.

duas.titleEn: Zakariyyā's Intimate Prayer for an Heir
duas.excerptUthmani: رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَلَمْ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا ۝ وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّا ۝ يَرِثُنِى وَيَرِثُ مِنْ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَٱجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy. And indeed I fear the successors after me… so give me from Yourself a heir who will inherit from me and inherit from the family of Yaʿqūb. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You].

duas.excerptUthmani: رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى ۝ وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى ۝ وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِى ۝ يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance] and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech.

duas.excerptUthmani: رَّبِّ زِدْنِى عِلْمًا
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

duas.excerptUthmani: أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
duas.meaningEn: Indeed, adversity has touched me, and you are the Most Merciful of the merciful.

duas.excerptUthmani: لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
duas.meaningEn: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

duas.titleAr: دعاء زكريا وطلب الوارث في الأنبياء
duas.excerptUthmani: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while you are the best of inheritors.

duas.titleEn: The Prophet's Prayer for Allah's Just Judgment
duas.excerptUthmani: رَبِّ ٱحْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَرَبُّنَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, judge in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one sought for help against what you describe.

duas.excerptUthmani: رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ ۝ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils, and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me.

duas.titleEn: Closing Prayer of Al-Muʾminūn — Forgive and Have Mercy
duas.excerptUthmani: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.

duas.titleEn: Prayer of the ʿIbād al-Raḥmān — Away from Hellfire
duas.titleAr: دعاء عباد الرحمن بصرف عذاب جهنم
duas.excerptUthmani: رَبَّنَا ٱصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا ۝ إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
duas.meaningEn: Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering. Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence.

duas.excerptUthmani: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
duas.meaningEn: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader [i.e., example] for the righteous.

duas.excerptUthmani: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ ۝ وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ ۝ وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ ۝ وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ ۝ وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ ۝ يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ ۝ إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, grant me wisdom and join me with the righteous. And grant me a reputation of honour among later generations. And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure. And forgive my father — indeed he has been of those astray. And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected — the Day when neither wealth nor children will avail, except one who comes to Allah with a sound heart.

duas.excerptUthmani: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَـٰلِحًا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِى بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِى عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favour which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants.

duas.excerptUthmani: رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى فَٱغْفِرْ لِى
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me.

duas.titleEn: Mūsā's Escape Prayer — Save Me from the Oppressors
duas.titleAr: دعاء موسى بطلب النجاة من القوم الظالمين
duas.excerptUthmani: رَبِّ نَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people.

duas.titleEn: Mūsā's Prayer of Need — I Am Poor to Whatever Good You Bestow
duas.titleAr: دعاء موسى في الفقر والحاجة — رب إني لما أنزلت إلي من خير فقير
duas.excerptUthmani: رَبِّ إِنِّى لِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ إِلَىَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.

duas.excerptUthmani: رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, help me against the corrupting people.

duas.titleEn: Ibrahim's Simple Prayer for a Righteous Child
duas.excerptUthmani: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous.

duas.titleEn: Sulaymān's Prayer for Forgiveness and a Unique Kingdom
duas.titleAr: دعاء سليمان بالمغفرة وملكٍ لا ينبغي لأحد من بعده
duas.excerptUthmani: رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower.

duas.excerptUthmani: رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا فَٱغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ ۝ رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدتَّهُمْ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ ءَابَآئِهِمْ وَأَزْوَٰجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ۝ وَقِهِمُ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ ۚ وَمَن تَقِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُۥ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
duas.meaningEn: Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire. Our Lord, admit them to gardens of perpetual residence and whoever was righteous among their fathers, spouses and offspring. Indeed it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise. And protect them from the evil consequences. And whoever You protect from evil consequences that Day — You will have given him mercy. And that is the great attainment.

duas.titleEn: Believer of Pharaoh's Court — I Entrust My Affair to Allah
duas.titleAr: إعلان مؤمن آل فرعون التفويض الكامل لله
duas.excerptUthmani: وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
duas.meaningEn: And I entrust my affair to Allah. Indeed, Allah is Seeing of His servants.

duas.excerptUthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقْرِنِينَ ۝ وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
duas.meaningEn: Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it. And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return.

duas.excerptUthmani: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَـٰلِحًا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِى فِى ذُرِّيَّتِىٓ ۖ إِنِّى تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّى مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favour which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims.

duas.titleEn: Nūḥ's Brief Plea After 950 Years — I Am Overcome, Help Me
duas.titleAr: دعاء نوح الموجز بعد تسعة وخمسين قرنًا — إني مغلوب فانتصر
duas.excerptUthmani: أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
duas.meaningEn: Indeed, I am overcome, so help me.

duas.excerptUthmani: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَٰنِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِٱلْإِيمَـٰنِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِى قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
duas.meaningEn: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful.

duas.titleAr: دعاء إبراهيم في الممتحنة — التوكل والإنابة
duas.excerptUthmani: رَّبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ ۝ رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
duas.meaningEn: Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination. Our Lord, make us not [objects of] trial for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

duas.titleEn: Prayer for Complete Light on Judgment Day
duas.excerptUthmani: رَبَّنَآ أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.meaningEn: Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent.

duas.excerptUthmani: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ
duas.meaningEn: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women.

duas.titleAr: سورة الفلق — الاستعاذة من شر المخلوقات
duas.excerptUthmani: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَـٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
duas.meaningEn: Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, from the evil of that which He created, and from the evil of darkness when it settles, and from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.'

duas.excerptUthmani: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝ إِلَـٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ ۝ ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
duas.meaningEn: Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the Sovereign of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer — who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind — from among the jinn and mankind.'
